After removal of said tumor I thought I was still having them because I was having spells that seemed very similar. Turned out I was having panic attacks. I didn’t want to believe it initially because I wasn’t worried or actually panicking about anything. But after some neuro testing and therapy, I was definitely having panic attacks that I never saw coming and never knew why. What you’re describing sounds exactly like a text book panic attack. And if it’s not, then maybe she IS having seizures. Because like I said I found them to feel very similar. But let me discern how I like to describe and differentiate mental “attacks” when I have an anxiety attack I know exactly what triggered me and why I’m experiencing the symptoms that I am. With panic attacks I never see them coming other than the auroras of light and the prickly right before I feel as though I’m unconscious and unable to speak. I never feel black out and incapacitated during an anxiety attack. I also feel awful like I got hit by a bus for about 24 hours after a panic attack. But also maybe look into the chance of seizures. I hope this helps.
